clips.title: The story
paras: The Skittering Dark is an abandoned mine and shadowy woodland hollow in western Silverpine Forest. Infested by aggressive giant spiders, the cavern and its surrounding woods are thick with webbing and danger for unwary beasts and travelers.

Tucked into the hills just east of the western coast of North Tide's Run, the Skittering Dark was once a working mine. Today, the shafts are completely choked with cobwebs, serving as the sprawling nest of giant spiders. With the shadowy weaver Krethis haunting the exterior, the spiders hunt anything that strays too close.
